hypotheses.summary: The cached spend totals are a derived copy that stopped being updated when purchases were recorded (from 2026-10-18T16:36:00Z). They began being served stale at 19:29:35Z. The purchase ledger is correct. No deploy, flag change or placement change explains it, so the cache maintenance or invalidation path is the likely fault. The evidence does not show which part of it failed.

supporting_evidence.claim: 90 of 240 cached spend figures disagree with the purchases behind them. The purchases are correct and the cached copies are behind; the oldest unaccounted purchase was recorded at 2026-10-18T16:36:00Z
